name: Illustration · Crayon
description: Wax crayon on toothed paper. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.

instructions.image: Wax crayon on toothed paper: back-and-forth scribble fills that skip the valleys, a darker crayon on the shade side, a white one burnishing the highlight, a fat contour gone over twice. A finished illustration in this one medium; never a photograph, a 3D render or a live-action frame. Use the attached reference frame for the medium, palette and line quality only, never for its subject.
instructions.motion: Slow camera drift and gentle parallax; marks settle in the way the medium is made. One focal action at a time.
instructions.composition: Keep all titles, labels, data and logos as editable HTML/SVG overlays. Use approved copy and supplied screenshots. Brand colors and fonts override reference palettes. Keep one style for the whole film.
instructions.negative: No generated text, logos, invented statistics or fake product UI. No unseeded randomness, render-time network or live clocks.
